question: Where was the 6th National Rafting Championship “The Ultimate River Battle” inaugurated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shibnote, Doda.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The 6th National Rafting Championship titled “The Ultimate River Battle”inaugurated at Shibnote in Doda district of Jammu and Kashmir.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• The championship was organised (19th to 22nd February 2026) on the Chenab River, known for its challenging rapids.
 
• The event aims to promote adventure tourism and position Jammu & Kashmir as a premier adventure sports destination.
 
• It is a four-day national-level sporting event.
 
• The event is organised by the J&K Tourism Department in collaboration with the Doda District Administration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Chenab River:** One of the major rivers of the Indus system, known for its fast-flowing currents and suitability for rafting competitions.
 
• **Doda District:** An emerging hub for eco-tourism and water sports in Jammu & Kashmir.
